description: Compute ideal body weight from height using the Robinson, Miller, Devine, and Hamwi formulas.

faqs.a: They estimate a healthy weight from height using slightly different base weights and per-inch factors, originally derived for medication dosing.
No single formula fits everyone — that is why all four are shown side by side as a range, not a verdict.
They are validated for adults around 152 cm and taller; results below that height are extrapolated and less reliable.
faqs.q: Do they work for short heights?

howto: Compare the four formula results and the overall healthy range.
title: Ideal Weight Calculator
